fields.description: One policy per company. Policies are never copied across companies automatically.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Master switch for NextGen automation in this company.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Route this company's agent runs to the Agent Runtime microservice.
fields.label: Runtime Enabled

fields.description: Shadow: signals and proposals only, no ERP documents. Approval Required: an approved proposal may create a Draft document after live revalidation. Automatic Draft: allowlisted items may create Draft documents. No mode submits a document.
fields.label: Default Mode

fields.description: Restricted, non-Desk service identity used for this company's runs. Administrator is rejected.
fields.label: Runtime Service User

fields.description: Model for this company's agent runs. Falls back to NextGen AI Settings when blank.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: One Warehouse per line. Empty means every non-group, enabled warehouse of this company.
fields.label: Allowed Warehouses

fields.description: One Item Group per line. Empty means all item groups.
fields.label: Allowed Item Groups

fields.description: One Item code per line. Automatic Draft mode only ever touches these items.
fields.label: Item Allowlist

fields.description: One Supplier per line. Empty means any linked supplier is acceptable.
fields.label: Supplier Allowlist

fields.description: One DocType per line that the assistant may propose creating, for example Item or Customer. Empty means none. This narrows a fixed code-level list and can never extend it; system and permission DocTypes are refused whatever is entered here.
fields.label: Assistant Writable DocTypes
